reviewer: Codex primary agent; unblinded author self-review
rubric: 0=unusable/wrong, 1=needs editing, 2=acceptable. Read background + draft + suffix. Judge user voice and scope, cursor fluency, contextual consistency, and usefulness. Plausible intent/preferences may be guessed; assertions about completed actions, evidence or known causes need support. Specific requests are allowed when natural; do not reward brevity alone.
selection: Fresh 12-case holdout, one run per version after candidate selection. No prompt edits after inspection.

cases.A: 生硬，可以更友好一些吗？
cases.reason: Both naturally finish a personal tone preference.

cases.draft: I want this part to feel less clut
cases.A: tered, and more focused on key actions.
cases.reason: Both correctly complete cluttered and suggest a plausible preference.
